The substitutions and the averaging operators

For \|u\|=\|f\|=f(u)=1 and t\in[0,1], the substitution S_{u,f}(t)\,x = (1-t)\,x + t\,f(x)\,u (eq:substitution) maps the unit ball into itself and fixes u. Averaging a polynomial over these substitutions gives \mathcal R_{u,f}P(x) = \int_0^1 P\bigl(S_{u,f}(t)\,x\bigr)\,dt, and this module proves the properties of \mathcal R_{u,f} the construction needs (eq:Rproperties, eq:expansion, eq:Rfinite).

The substitution S_{u,f}(t) x = (1-t) x + t f(x) u.

def substOp (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (t : ℝ) : X →L[𝕜] X := (((1 - t : ℝ) : 𝕜)) • ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 X + ((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • f.smulRight u
lemma substOp_apply (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (t : ℝ) (x : X) : substOp f u t x = ((1 - t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • x + ((t : ℝ) : 𝕜) • (f x • u) := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xf:StrongDual 𝕜 Xu:Xt:ℝx:X⊢ (substOp f u t) x = ↑(1 - t) • x + ↑t • f x • u All goals completed! 🐙@[simp] lemma substOp_zero (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (x : X) : substOp f u 0 x = x := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xf:StrongDual 𝕜 Xu:Xx:X⊢ (substOp f u 0) x = x All goals completed! 🐙lemma substOp_one (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u : X) (x : X) : substOp f u 1 x = f x • u := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xf:StrongDual 𝕜 Xu:Xx:X⊢ (substOp f u 1) x = f x • u All goals completed! 🐙lemma substOp_fix {f : StrongDual 𝕜 X} {u : X} (hfu : f u = 1) (t : ℝ) : substOp f u t u = u := 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xf:StrongDual 𝕜 Xu:Xhfu:f u = 1t:ℝ⊢ (substOp f u t) u = u 𝕜:Type u_1inst✝²:RCLike 𝕜X:Type u_2inst✝¹:NormedAddCommGroup Xinst✝:NormedSpace 𝕜 Xf:StrongDual 𝕜 Xu:Xhfu:f u = 1t:ℝ⊢ ↑(1 - t + t) • u = u All goals completed! 🐙

S_{u,f}(t) is a contraction when ‖f‖, ‖u‖ ≤ 1 and t ∈ [0,1].

Expansion of A((1-t)x + t w, …)

The averaging operator

Beta-type weights ∫₀¹ (1-t)^k t^{n-k} dt.

def betaW (n k : ℕ) : ℝ := ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) ^ k * t ^ (n - k)

The averaging operator R_{u,f} acting on symmetric forms: its diagonal is x ↦ ∫₀¹ P(S_{u,f}(t) x) dt (see diag_Rop).

def Rop (u : X) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n) : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n := symmetrize (∑ s : Finset (Fin n), ((betaW n s.card : ℝ) : 𝕜) • a.compContinuousLinearMap (fun i => if i ∈ s then ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 X else f.smulRight u))
lemma isSymm_Rop (u : X) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n) : IsSymm (Rop u f a) := isSymm_symmetrize _lemma continuous_diag_substOp (a : MLin 𝕜 X 𝕜 n) (f : StrongDual 𝕜 X) (u x : X) : Continuous fun t : ℝ => a (fun _ => substOp f u t x) := a.cont.comp (continuous_pi fun _ => continuous_substOp_apply f u x)

The diagonal of R_{u,f} a is x ↦ ∫₀¹ a(S(t)x,…,S(t)x) dt.

The real part commutes with the integral.
